questions.question: 아래 단어 중 알맞은 것을 골라 빈칸을 채우세요.
questions.explanation:
【Collocation 패턴 정리】

✅ role
패턴: the role is to + verb / play a role in
예문: The teacher's role is to guide students.

✅ assumption
패턴: founded on the assumption that / based on the assumption that
예문: The theory is based on the assumption that markets are efficient.
❌ information → assumption (founded on information은 어색한 표현)

✅ unlikely
패턴: highly unlikely / very unlikely / unlikely that
예문: It is highly unlikely that the plan will succeed.
❌ possible → unlikely (highly possible은 거의 안 씀)

✅ duty
패턴: undertake a duty / perform a duty / carry out a duty
예문: He undertook the duty of leading the team.
❌ task → duty (task는 complete/perform a task)

✅ provoke
패턴: provoke discussion / provoke debate / provoke reaction
예문: The article provoked a debate.
❌ commit → provoke (commit은 commit a crime / commit to a plan)
questions.memo: Collocation | role is to / founded on assumption / highly unlikely / undertake a duty / provoke discussion

questions.question: 【Collocation 복습 — 세미나】 다음 중 올바른 표현을 모두 고르세요.
questions.explanation:
핵심 Collocation 5가지:
• role is to + verb — 역할은 ~이다
• founded on the assumption that — ~라는 가정에 근거하다
• highly unlikely — 매우 가능성이 낮다
• undertake a duty — 책임을 맡다 (task는 complete/perform)
• provoke discussion — 토론을 촉발하다

questions.passage: More than simply putting flowers in a [BLANK], Ikebana is a [BLANK] art form that encompasses the aesthetic principles of Japanese culture. questions.question: 아래 단어 중 알맞은 것을 골라 빈칸을 채우세요.
questions.explanation:
【Collocation 패턴 정리】

✅ container
패턴: flowers in a container / put in a container
비슷한 표현: vase(꽃병), pot(화분), container(용기)
예문: She placed the flowers in a glass container.

✅ disciplined
패턴: disciplined art form / highly disciplined practice
예문: Ballet is a highly disciplined art form.
❌ creative → disciplined (문맥상 '체계적/규율 있는'이 맞음)

✅ arrangement
패턴: flower arrangement / arrangement of flowers / a multicolored arrangement
예문: She made a beautiful flower arrangement.
❌ collection → arrangement (arrangement는 의도적 배열, collection은 단순 모음)

✅ plant
패턴: parts of a plant / areas of the plant
예문: The leaves are important parts of the plant.
❌ flower → plant (flower는 꽃 자체, plant는 stems/leaves/branches 포함한 식물 전체)
questions.memo: Collocation | flowers in a container / disciplined art form / flower arrangement / parts of a plant

questions.question: 【Collocation 복습 — 이케바나】 다음 중 올바른 표현을 모두 고르세요.
questions.explanation:
핵심 Collocation 4가지:
• flowers in a container — 꽃을 용기에 넣다
• disciplined art form — 규율 있는 예술 형식
• flower arrangement — 꽃꽂이 / 의도적 배열
• parts of a plant — 식물의 부분 (stems, leaves, branches 포함)
